a.lede: Marvell's planned purchase of Lumentum is one of the biggest acquisitions in tech history. And they both have the same strategic investor: Nvidia.
a.title: In one of the largest deals in tech history, Marvell buys Lumentum for $115B

b.lede: Marvell has agreed to acquire Lumentum for $115 billion, combining its optical DSPs, SerDes, silicon photonics, and networking silicon with Lumentum’s lasers, transceivers, optical switches, and InP manufacturing footprint.
b.title: Marvell to buy Lumentum in $115 billion all-stock deal
